title: Aria for the Missing Interval
alignment: Authored times reference decoded original MP3. Canonical MP3 timing is verified against that recording; no additional entrance delay.

cues.text: Do not return the hour you did not keep.
Do not invent a childhood for the stone.
The light is real upon this borrowed page.
The road is longer than the road I know.
I cannot bring the vanished rain to falling.
I cannot make a record into skin.
Then let the space remain between the calling.
A space through which another can come in.
You have the promise, not the hand that made it.
I have the chance to answer it today.
A different voice can carry an old kindness.
A different voice can choose a different way.
If I return, I will return with listening.
If I am gone, leave room beside the flame.
You are the work of tending what was given.
And what I change will have to bear my name.
